description: List the pitches the investor has saved on PitchSpark (in the app or with pitchspark_watch_pitch_v1), newest first: id, company name, stage, sector, when saved and the link. Use when: the investor asks what is on their watchlist or saved pitches. Do not use for: saving (pitchspark_watch_pitch_v1), searching. Requires a PitchSpark API key from an investor account (self-declared; PitchSpark does not verify accreditation). Pitches that are no longer public or whose founders opted out of AI agents are left out and counted in unavailable_count. Up to 50 items. Uses none of the daily pitch allowance. Read-only. Calls are logged.
name: pitchspark_list_watchlist_v1

error.description: Present only when the call failed (isError true).

code.description: Machine-readable error code, e.g. RATE_LIMITED, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, INVALID_ARGUMENT, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, PITCH_LIMIT_REACHED, INTERNAL.

message.description: A short human-readable explanation, safe to show the user. Never a stack trace.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, when waiting helps.

retryable.description: true when the same call can succeed later without changes.

title: Investors: list the startup pitches saved to your PitchSpark watchlist
